description: This file defines a React component named VideoCaptureModal that provides a user interface for recording, previewing, and uploading video clips. It manages recorder state, interface controls, and interacts with external controllers for file handling.

methods.name: VideoCaptureModal
methods.description: Main React component that encapsulates video recording, preview, and upload functionalities.

methods.name: saveVideo
methods.description: Creates a file object from the recorded video and uploads it via the filesController.

methods.name: stopRecording
methods.description: Stops the video recording and stores the captured video.

methods.name: retryRecording
methods.description: Resets the recording process, allowing a new video to be recorded.
